---
title: "Bitcoin daily prices"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)",
    title = "Bitcoin daily price"
  )
```

```{r}
prices |>
  inner_join(read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet"), by = "coin_id") |>
  inner_join(read_parquet("data/categories.parquet"), by = "category_id") |>
  group_by(date_raw, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(date_raw) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)) |>
  ungroup() -> category_shares

category_order <- category_shares |>
  group_by(category_name) |>
  summarise(typical_share = median(category_share), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(typical_share)) |>
  pull(category_name)

event_windows <- tibble(
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11")),
  label = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  label_date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
  label_y = c(0.98, 0.88)
)

category_shares |>
  mutate(category_name = factor(category_name, levels = category_order)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  geom_rect(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(xintercept = start),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Bitcoin" = "#E69F00",
      "DeFi" = "#009E73",
      "Exchange Token" = "#0072B2",
      "Meme Coin" = "#D55E00",
      "Smart Contract Platform" = "#56B4E9",
      "Stablecoin" = "#CC79A7"
    ),
    breaks = category_order
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of summed market cap",
    fill = "Category (ordered by median share)",
    title = "Crypto market-cap share shifts across categories",
    subtitle = "Daily shares of market cap across categorized coins in this dataset\n(each day totals 100%).",
    caption = "Source: PPBDS misc.tutorials r4ds-7 daily prices and coin-category metadata."
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 12, b = 12, l = 12)
  )
```
